messages.message: Austria here. I'm going defensive and taking Serbia this spring. I'm not planning to move on anyone's home centers. Italy: I'll keep TRI and VEN quiet if you do the same. Russia: I'll stay out of GAL and RUM while you hold WAR and SEV. Happy to talk about a Balkan split with whoever wants one.

England here. I'm playing for a peaceful, defensive opening and will not attack anyone in 1901. Happy to discuss non-aggression with any power that wants it. Tell me your plans, and let's keep the Channel and North Sea quiet while we all grow.

France here. I propose peace for 1901. I will not attack anyone who does not attack me. Neutral centers are open to all: I plan to take SPA and POR and possibly BEL. Germany and England, I'd like to keep Burgundy and the Channel quiet this year. Italy, I'm happy to leave you Tunis and the Adriatic if you leave Marseilles and Spain to me. Let's all aim for a stable 1901.

Germany here. I'm playing for a peaceful build-up in the north and centre. I'm moving toward Denmark and Holland, which are unowned, and I won't attack anyone who keeps out of my home centres. Happy to discuss a non-aggression pact with anyone who wants one.

Italy here. I propose we both stay out of each other's home centers this year. I won't move on TRI or VIE, and I'd like the same from you on VEN and ROM. If you want to focus south-east on Turkey or Russia, I'm happy to keep my northern border quiet. Let me know what you think.
Italy to France: I have no plans to attack you. I'm willing to keep PIE/MAR quiet and leave you free to deal with England or Spain. Would you be open to a non-aggression pact for 1901?

Russia here. I'm playing defensively and have no interest in an early fight. I propose no attacks on each other's home centers in 1901-1902. Turkey: I'll keep my fleet out of the Black Sea if you keep yours out of Sevastopol and Armenia. Austria: I won't contest Galicia or Rumania this year if you stay out of Warsaw and Ukraine. Happy to hear other proposals.

Turkey here. I propose we both stay out of each other's home centers in 1901. I will take BUL and the Black Sea-south. Your F SEV can go to RUM or BLA as you like, but I'd ask that you not move into ANK or CON. If you agree, I'll keep my fleet out of SEV and avoid Armenia/Russian centers. Let me know your plan.

Austria: agreed. I won't move on TRI or VEN this year and I'll stay out of ROM and NAP. Please keep your units out of TRI, VIE and BUD. I'm taking Serbia, so Balkan neutrals are fine with me. If you want to split Balkan centers later, let's talk.
Austria: agreed on Galicia and Rumania for 1901. I'm taking Serbia and won't go toward WAR or UKR. I'd like your word that you won't push into GAL or BOH. Let's both keep the peace.

England, round 2. Thanks all. I'm also defensive for 1901. Proposal: no moves into the North Sea, English Channel, or Norway by anyone except as agreed. France: I'll keep the Channel quiet if you keep Brest out of ENG and Picardy/Belgium out of London's reach. Germany: Holland and Denmark are fine for you to take, but please don't move into Belgium with a fleet. Russia and Austria: good luck in the east, I'm staying out of it. Anyone who breaks this, I'll respond in kind.
France to Italy: Agreed, no attack from me on you in 1901. I'll keep MAR and PIE quiet on my side if you keep your fleets out of MAR and SPA. Tunis is yours to take if you want it.
France: I'm also playing for peace in 1901. I'm moving on the neutral centers SPA, POR and BEL only. I won't attack any power's home centers this year. Let's keep the Channel and Burgundy calm.

Germany to France: I'm taking Denmark and Holland this spring, and I'll stay out of Belgium and Spain. Your Burgundy is safe from me if you keep out of Munich, Ruhr and Kiel. Let's both stay peaceful in 1901 and I'll keep watching the Channel with you.

Germany to Russia: agreed, no attacks on each other's home centres in 1901-1902. I'm staying west of Berlin and Silesia, and I'll keep my units out of Warsaw and Prussia unless you move against me first. Let's keep the Baltic quiet.

Germany: I'm for peace this year and I'll attack no one who respects my home centres (BER, KIE, MUN). Happy to back a unanimous draw later if the board stays stable, but for now let's all grow in neutral territory.

Italy to Austria: Agreed on the northern border. I won't touch TRI or VIE. I'm also staying out of VEN-side Balkan fights for now. If you take Serbia, I'd ask that you don't push into ADR or ALB against me.

Italy to France: Agreed. I'll keep Piedmont and Marseilles quiet, and I'll leave Spain and Portugal to you. I plan to aim for Tunis and possibly Greece later, so I'd ask you not to send fleets into the Tyrrhenian or Ionian.

Italy here. I'm playing peacefully in 1901 and want no fights with anyone. I'm open to non-aggression with all neighbors and will honor any pact made. Neutral centers (TUN, GRE, SER, RUM) are open to whoever takes them first, so let's avoid bouncing each other there.

Russia to Turkey: Agreed. I won't move into ANK or CON, and I'll keep F SEV out of your Black Sea coasts this year. My SEV holds in 1901. If you want to take BUL and SER-area centers, I won't contest them. Let's both keep Armenia and Syria quiet.
Russia to Austria: Fine by me. Take Serbia and I'll leave it alone. I'm holding WAR and SEV and won't enter GAL or RUM this spring. Let's keep the border calm and revisit in 1902.

Russia to Germany: I'm not planning any move on you. If you want to coordinate against a France or Austria push later, let's talk. For now, I'm building up in the east and taking Sweden and Norway if they're open.

Turkey: agreed on your terms. I keep my fleets out of SEV and the Black Sea north of BUL. I'm taking BUL and GRE only. Please keep F SEV away from ANK and CON and I'll do the same with Armenia and Sevastopol. Let's both build up in 1901-1902.

Turkey here. I'm going for BUL and GRE this year, not Serbia. Austria, take SER as you planned. I'm happy to keep the Balkans split this way. Italy, I'll stay out of the Adriatic and Ionian if you do the same.

Turkey here. I'm going for BUL and GRE this year, not Serbia. Austria, take SER as you planned. I'm happy to keep the Balkans split this way. Italy, I'll stay out of the Adriatic and Ionian if you do the same.

Austria to Turkey: agreed. I take SER and stay out of BUL and GRE. I'll keep my units out of RUM and BUL this spring. Please keep your fleets out of the Adriatic and Trieste's waters, and I'll do the same toward you. Let's keep the Balkan split.
Austria to Italy: confirmed. No moves on TRI, VEN, ROM or NAP from me this year. Please keep your fleets out of ADR and ALB while I'm taking SER, and we're fine.

France: Confirming my 1901 plan. I'm moving on SPA, POR and BEL only. I'll keep Brest out of the Channel and won't move into Munich, Ruhr or Kiel. Please keep your fleets out of Gascony, Spain and Picardy this year and we'll both stay peaceful.

France: Confirming my 1901 plan. I'm moving on SPA, POR and BEL only. I'll keep Brest out of the Channel and won't move into Munich, Ruhr or Kiel. Please keep your fleets out of Gascony, Spain and Picardy this year and we'll both stay peaceful.

Italy to Turkey: Agreed, I'll keep my fleets out of the Adriatic and Ionian toward you. I'm not going for GRE or BUL, so the Balkans are yours. In return, please keep your fleets out of the Ionian and away from TUN and NAP.
Italy to France: Confirmed. I'm going for TUN this year and will leave SPA, POR and MAR to you. Please keep fleets out of the Tyrrhenian and Ionian.
Russia to Austria: Confirmed. I won't enter GAL, BOH or RUM in 1901 while you take Serbia. I'm holding WAR and SEV. Let's keep it that way and talk again in 1902.
Russia to Germany: Agreed, no attacks on each other's home centres in 1901-1902. If France or Austria pushes on you, let me know. I'm open to coordinating.
Russia to Turkey: Confirmed. F SEV stays out of your coasts and I won't enter ANK or CON. Good luck taking BUL and GRE.

Turkey, round 3: Confirmed. No Turkish fleet or army enters SEV, the Black Sea north of BUL, or Armenia/Russian homes. I'm taking BUL and GRE only. Please keep F SEV off ANK and CON. Let's both hold this line through 1901-1902.
Turkey to Italy: I'll keep my fleets out of the Adriatic and Ionian. Greece is my target this year, and I won't move into Tunis or your home centers. Let's both stay clear of each other.
Austria, round 4: I'm holding to the agreements. I take SER only this spring, with no moves on TRI, VEN, ROM, NAP, GAL, RUM, BUL or GRE. I'm open to a stable 1902 with anyone who keeps their word.

England, round 4: I'm still for peace in 1901 and will not attack anyone who keeps out of the Channel, North Sea and my home centres (EDI, LON, LVP). France and Germany: please confirm you'll keep fleets out of ENG and NTH. I'll hold my fleets in place and make no moves into your areas. Let's aim for a stable board and a possible unanimous draw later.

France, round 4: Still peaceful for 1901. My moves are SPA, POR and BEL only. I won't touch any home centre or move a fleet into the Channel. Italy, thanks for confirming TUN. Germany and England, if you keep to your stated plans, I'll keep Burgundy and Brest quiet too.

Germany, round 4: unchanged. I'm taking Denmark and Holland this spring and moving no units into Belgium, Spain or Portugal. I'm not attacking any home centre. If France or Austria moves on Munich, Berlin or Kiel, I'll respond. Open to a Baltic arrangement with Russia.
Italy, round 4: I'm holding peace in 1901. My only move is a fleet toward Tunis. I'll honor the pacts with Austria, France and Turkey and won't enter TRI, VIE, MAR, SPA or the Balkans.

Turkey, round 4: I'm holding to the plan. Fleets stay out of SEV, the Black Sea north of BUL, the Adriatic, Ionian, and Tunis. I'm taking BUL and GRE this year. Anyone who keeps to these lines can count on me doing the same. I'm open to a stable Balkan and eastern Mediterranean split.
Austria, final round for 1901: I'm taking SER only and keeping TRI, VIE, BUD and VEN/ROM/NAP, GAL, RUM, BUL and GRE untouched. I'm open to a unanimous draw later if the board stays stable.

England, round 5: Final note for 1901. I'm holding my fleets at home and making no moves into anyone's home centres. France, Germany: if you keep out of ENG, NTH, LON, EDI and LVP, I'll stay put. Happy to talk about a unanimous draw once the board is stable.

France, round 5: Final word for 1901. I'm moving on SPA and heading a fleet toward POR, and I'm moving toward BEL only through neutral space. I will not attack any home centre. Germany and England, you both said you're taking HOL, DEN and staying out of BEL, so let's keep that. Italy, your Tunis move is fine by me. I'd welcome a stable 1902 and a unanimous draw once the board settles.

Germany, round 5: final confirmation. This spring I move F KIE-DEN, A MUN-RUH and A BER-KIE. No units into Belgium, Spain, Portugal, England, the Channel or the North Sea. I will not attack any home centre. Russia, I'm keeping to our no-attack pact on home centres for 1901-02. Let's aim for a stable board and a possible unanimous draw later.

Italy, round 5: Holding the agreements. My only move this spring is a fleet toward Tunis (NAP/ROM via ION/TYS). I will not enter TRI, VIE, MAR, SPA, POR or the Balkans, and I won't attack anyone who keeps to their word. Open to a stable 1902 and a later unanimous draw if the board holds.

Russia, round 5: I'm holding to every agreement: no entry into ANK, CON, GAL, BOH or RUM in 1901, no fleets into the Black Sea south of SEV, and no home-centre attacks on Germany. My orders this spring are defensive. Let's keep 1901 quiet and revisit a stable 1902 board.

Turkey, round 5: Final reaffirmation. I keep fleets out of SEV, the Black Sea north of BUL, ADR, ION and TUN, and I take BUL and GRE this spring. Anyone who keeps these lines has my word of the same. If the board stays stable through 1901-1902, I'm open to a unanimous draw vote later.

ENGLAND: F NTH S F ENG - BEL
GERMANY: A KIE S A RUH - HOL

England, your fleets now sit in ENG and NTH with an army in YOR. I expect those stay out of BRE and PIC, and I'll keep my units out of ENG, NTH, YOR, LON and EDI. France: you took SPA and PIC; I'll leave Belgium to you if you leave Holland and Denmark to me. England: keep your fleets out of DEN and HOL and we're fine. Russia: our Baltic and home-centre pact still stands.

Italy, Fall 1901 round 1: Thanks for keeping the spring peaceful. I'm still holding my pacts. My fleet in the Tyrrhenian is headed for Tunis in 1902. I won't move on TRI, VIE, MAR, SPA, POR or the Balkans. Let's keep the board stable into 1902.

France to Germany: I'm moving into Belgium and POR this fall. I'll stay out of KIE, BER, MUN and HOL. Please keep your units out of BEL and BUR.

Germany to England: I'm taking Holland this autumn and Belgium stays neutral for me. Your fleet into Belgium would be a direct move on the same centre, so let's agree: you take BEL, I take HOL, and neither of us moves into the other's target. I'll keep my fleets out of ENG and NTH.
Germany to France: I'm taking Holland this fall. I'll leave Belgium to you if you keep out of Kiel, Ruhr and Munich. Please don't move into Ruhr or Burgundy against me.
Italy, Fall 1901 round 1: Still holding the pacts. My fleet in the Tyrrhenian is headed for Tunis in 1902. No moves planned on any home centre. Let's keep the board stable into 1902.

Russia, F1901 round 1 correction: I'm NOT taking Rumania this fall. I'll keep my 1901 word to Austria and stay out of RUM. My only move is toward unowned Sweden (F BOT-SWE). Germany, please don't contest SWE. Turkey, I'm keeping to our Black Sea and SEV/ARM lines. Let's hold a stable 1902.
Russia to Austria: Keeping my word. No move into RUM, GAL or BOH this fall. My only move is F BOT to SWE. I'll revisit Rumania only in 1902 and only after talking to you.
